english: 1 "You who stand before me are remarkable. We have tested you by trial, and you have pledged yourself to a cause that will change you forever. "
10 "And when we arrived here, you created a city worthy of Glint's pride. Your work here pleased and humbled me and the other Forgotten."
11 "We raised this haven at the edge of Mordremoth's jungle, but no Elder Dragon can touch us here. Our magic shields the city from them."
12 "Your friends and families have no less important a charge. The Brotherhood of the Dragon passed its mantle on to them."
13 "They're calling themselves Zephyrites after the gentle, ever-moving breeze of their homeland, and none but their inner circle will know their secret mission."
14 "Glint's legacy is far more than just her offspring, and you must protect it all."
16 "As the last Forgotten, I have come to understand the vastness of history and the ephemeral nature of truth."
17 "You do it to ensure that this world you love continues on after you're gone. Glint's dream of a harmonious future can come to pass. Now you carry the torch of her benevolence."
18 Slots. If possible, junk items will fill this box before other empty spaces. The contents of this box will not move when inventory is sorted.
3 "You look upon me and see the sunset of our race. I am the last of the Forgotten."
5 "In olden times, when the Dragons stirred, it fell to the Seers to set aside a reservoir of magic for the upcoming drought."
7 "Glaust has been known by many names, and even we do not know her true name. She is called Glint in these modern times, and she entrusted us with using her legacy for Tyria."
8 "We began our journey among the magical canyons of the Lost Precipice, and when it no longer served us, we moved on."

9 "En route to our final destination, we sheltered in a hollow and performed the exalting rituals, but ultimately, we left there as well. One day, Tarir will no longer serve us, and you will move on."

A Dominion tribune has appeared in Frostvein Watch. Defeat them to take control of the region!
A Pact fixed upon the Orrian shore...
A barrier is protecting this unit from damage. Use EMP pulses or mines to remove the barrier.
A beating this bad should be illegal.
A blizzard has encompassed the region. Havroun Weibe is channeling energy to summon Raven and drive the storm back.
A blizzard is approaching. Jora's Keep is building defenses in preparation of an assault by Jormag's forces.
A bunch of dredge tried to ambush me. I killed them all, then burned down their camp.
A capable lady like yourself should be able to do more than watch.
A cave in the forest... That's where Jhavi is. And the lens—must be reacting because of her. But what about Almorra?
A cloud of disease surrounds the drake.
A colossal icebrood elemental has engaged allies on the bridge.
A competition being run alongside the festival. During the treasure hunt, bundles of loot are hidden all around the area.

A crumpled piece of parchment holds an ominous order. "Pull out. Go underground, away from prying eyes. Carry all you can and stay ahead of the Mordrem. You will hear from your superior in good time."
A dead bandit. Our soldiers must have put up a fight.
A decent selection of foods is available here. Most of the fare is locally grown, but a few exotic selections have been brought in via asura gate.
A destroyer champion has erupted from the ground at the Hawke Heart. Stop it before Ebonhawke falls!
A divine flavor that restores, reinvigorates, and even prevents hangovers.
A fascinating book? I don't think so.
A fellow patron of the explosive arts! Good to meet you. Stick close, pal. I'm sure we'll be leveling stuff in no time.
A fellow traveler! I bet we've both seen our share of excitement. Me, I've been to the ends of Tyria—even built a few things along the way. Happy to share some friendly advice if it helps.
A few of us are going to sneak out later? Are you in?
A few of us are pitching in to help him make his quota until he's back on his feet.
A fine spore cluster harvest, gatherer. I challenge you to do better.
A former "colleague"? What does that mean, exactly?
A former...uh, colleague...said that the bandits in the camp to the south are planning a strike on the Seraph outpost at Hidden Lake.
A fun party trick, but I don't know if I'd want just anyone to get their hands on a bot... I quite like my privacy.
A giant destroyer is rampaging through Pinion Pass! Please, you've got to help!
A gold for some peace and quiet, you chattering grawl!
A group of legionnaires is looking for help to investigate Doomlore Shrine.
A gust of wind is blocking access to the cavern below.
A harmless elemental stares at you, terrified.
A heavy task. I'll do what I can to aid you.
A hunting party went missing near the Grawlenfjord three days ago. I scouted the nearby cave and saw grawl and...something grisly. We're going to make it leave: alive or dead.
A journal. There appear to be pages missing.
A little absentminded, are you? Here, let me write it down for you again.
A little help here? I can't take the spore out alone!
A little to the left, and...
A local nickname for the Nightmare Court, bandit, and Inquest who've joined forces. The triad is tormenting Brisban Wildlands, and we don't have the numbers to stop them.
A lot of families with cubs are thinking about leaving.
A lot of the ward here are rather dressed up. They look nice.
A matching seer power attunement is required to damage this target.
A memorial for Eir. You couldn't have brought a better gift!
A minor miscalculation, nothing more. I'm not going to bore you with the specifics, but suffice to say that heads will roll when I return to my base.
A mursaat, yes. And I'm sure that isn't the biggest shock you've received today.
A mystical army arrived from the north. Most of the charr broke off and, in feral bloodlust, charged the illusion. Koro's trick bought us the time we needed to prepare for the next assault.
A nearby shield progenitor is guarding this artifact. Destroy it!
A new game is beginning in: %str1%
A new riddle wafts across the air, "The penultimate stone is that which is nearest the columns tri—umphant."
A pain so terrible, it chains increasing damage to nearby allies.
A pile of enemy bodies, a base back in our hands. This is a good day.
A problem? You could say that. I just wish the Seraph could do something about it. I know there's a hideout nearby.
A proper hunt takes time. I need to commune with Hare for a while.
A prototype of some sort...maybe a drill? While its exterior definitely dredge made, its inner components are of Flame Legion design. It burns to the touch.
A rescue party...then Wolf did hear me. In here...they're starving us...no food or water for days.
A rift was opened, and something came through! Those primitive skritt.
A scared elemental looks at you nervously.
A scholarly argument for the symmetry between Elder Dragons and the human gods. Unfortunately, by the end, it is clear that no proof exists to support this theory.
A second base is being established at the tunnel exit. They can use some protection.
A seven course meal would really hit the spot right about now.
A sharkskin bound book rests on what is left of the ship's chart table. The markings on front identify it as the ship captain's log.
A simple memorial marks the final resting place of Ascalonian hero and Ebon Vanguard Commander, Gwen Thackeray—loving wife of Lieutenant Keiran Thackeray and ancestor to Captain Logan Thackeray.
A slightly weathered book lies before you with a faint smell of salt and sand.
A small, frightened elemental looks up at you timidly.
A sound plan. Let's do it!
A splint is being applied. More splints can be applied.
A statue of an asura among our legendary heroes? Odd.
A statue of an older asura, his features mischievous, kind, and careworn. An area on the statue has been left open for an inscription. Above this space is the simple title "Snaff," and nothing more.
A steward arm is trying to strike you. Drop it off at the appropriate workstation.
A stiff drink. I've got a stash that I was saving for a special occasion, and I think this qualifies. Care to join?
A stolen Inquest hoverbike with limited fuel. It will disappear when time runs out.
A subtle, warm glow clings to you, but you sense it will not last long.
A survey team has begun their trek through Bava Nisos, and the surveying process has begun.
A survey team is preparing to depart on a research expedition in the Nexus of Moonlight. Help them craft bows and tranquilizers.
A taste of delicious meat fills you with power. Beware—too much will cause a meat coma.
A toast to you, honored guests. Eat, drink, and join me in my salon for lively conversation.

A traveler looking to lend a helping hand will find a lot to do in these parts. The Durmand Priory has discovered ancient ruins near the canyons. The Priory's stubborn determination to explore them is starting to cost lives, as the ruins are far from safe. Firebreak Fort is one of the Pact's camps ramping up for the fight against the Risen. Any and all help to prepare for that fight will be welcome.
A trial is currently in progress. You cannot join right now.
A tripletail temaki sounds really good right now.
A voice on the wind offered her exactly what she wanted. But it wasn't Koda she heard.
A warm greeting to you. I'm looking for a Valla Holmgard original. Have you seen any here in Hoelbrak?
A word, Countess? Ever since the planning phases of this event, I've been kept out of every important decision involving the queen.
A workshop, huh? What are you working on?
A world without dragons? We probably won't either.
A worthy goal. I'll see you later.

A. Joko defeated Turai Ossa and burned his body.
A. Joko did it to punish the humans in the north.
A. Joko forced the gods to leave by his will alone.
A. Joko had nothing to do with it.
A. Joko is a direct descendant of King Jahnus.
A. Joko is touring the distant corners of his kingdom.
A. Joko lured the dragon here in order to defeat it.
A. Joko was drowning Vabbi's enemies to the north.
A. They wish to prove their worth to Joko.
Aaargh. Belly on up here and let's see if you got the gumption to win at a game of Belcher's Bluff. <c=@warning>Remember, food and rejuvenation booster buffs will be removed when the game begins.</c>
About those other things you mentioned.
About time we had a decent scrap. Let's chop some vines!
Absolutely not! That's way too much.
Absolutely. I learned my lesson last time. The less time the body rots and festers in the sun, the better.
Absolutely. It's better to pull out the one brick that brings the whole thing down.
